groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.766% and the 10Y at 5.196%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 5 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -1.34% over five sessions and +0.90% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -1.56% at about $104.99, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-1/100, 55% confidence, improving ↑). The current balance is falling oil, semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.196%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
